bootstrapCancelRequested.message: Cancellation of the browser sign-in was requested; waiting for the flow to end…

bootstrapUnavailableTitle.message: The browser sign-in component is not installed. Run the install script again.
bootstrapUnavailableTitle.description: Tooltip when the browser login component is unavailable.

bootstrapReloginTitle.message: Sign in again (this overwrites the existing credentials)
bootstrapReloginTitle.description: Tooltip of the login button when credentials exist.

bootstrapLoginTitle.message: Sign in to your Mozilla account in a browser window
bootstrapLoginTitle.description: Tooltip of the login button when no credentials exist.

usageQuerying.description: Usage line while the query runs.

usageUnlimited.description: Usage line when the account has no cap.

usagePlan.description: Usage summary. $1 is the plan size, $2 the used amount, $3 the remaining amount.

usageResetSuffix.description: Appended to the usage summary when a reset time is known. $1 is the reset time.

confirmRemoveLocal.message:
Delete the local component?

The extension stays, but the VPN will not work until the local component is installed again.
confirmRemoveLocal.description: Confirmation dialog before deleting the local component.

noticeRemovingLocal.message: The local component is being deleted.
noticeRemovingLocal.description: Notice shown while the local component is removed.

confirmFullUninstall.message:
Fully uninstall Firefox IP Protection Bridge?

This turns off the VPN, deletes the local component and the credentials, and uninstalls the extension from Chrome.
confirmFullUninstall.description: Confirmation dialog before a full uninstall.

fingerprintTitle.description: Title of the fingerprint-shield toggle in the privacy block.

fingerprintDetailDefault.message: Adds per-site noise to canvas, WebGL and audio reads, and rounds CPU and memory hints.
fingerprintDetailDefault.description: Explains the fingerprint shield before its state is known.

fingerprintActive.message: On. Canvas, WebGL and audio reads carry per-site noise; CPU and memory hints are rounded. Font lists are not hidden: that needs browser support.
fingerprintActive.description: Detail line while the fingerprint shield is on.

fingerprintOff.message: Off. Pages read your real canvas, WebGL and audio values.
fingerprintOff.description: Detail line while the fingerprint shield is off.

noticeFingerprintOn.description: Notice after enabling the fingerprint shield.

noticeFingerprintOff.description: Notice after disabling the fingerprint shield.

errUnknownFingerprintOption.description: Error for an unrecognised fingerprint-shield option.
